summary: Iter52 testing — Messagerie router extraction regression + new PWA dynamic manifest / icon endpoints. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (list / open / send / get / archive / pin / react / broadcast / customer messages / manifest+icons incl. user logo). Frontend: /console/messagerie loads and renders conversation list correctly. CRITICAL frontend bug: id='dynamic-manifest' is stripped by CRA HtmlWebpackPlugin from the served index.html (dynamic-favicon and dynamic-apple-icon ids are preserved, only manifest id is dropped), so getElementById('dynamic-manifest') returns null and the backend-generated manifest is never applied — the install icon will NOT track the merchant logo.

integration_issues.issue: Served index.html loses id="dynamic-manifest" (CRA/HtmlWebpackPlugin normalizes <link rel="manifest">). document.getElementById('dynamic-manifest') is null at runtime, so BrandingBootstrapper never swaps href to /api/public/manifest.webmanifest. Install icon will keep using static /manifest.json instead of the backend-generated one. Reproduced on both the preview URL and localhost:3000. Note the sibling dynamic-favicon and dynamic-apple-icon ids ARE preserved.

action_items: Fix BrandingBootstrapper: use document.querySelector('link[rel="manifest"]') (fallback) instead of getElementById('dynamic-manifest'), and set its id when found. Alt: in index.html, keep rel + id but also set a data attribute, or disable HtmlWebpackPlugin minify for the manifest link.
After the fix, re-verify on /boutique: `document.querySelector('link[rel=manifest]').href` must contain '/api/public/manifest.webmanifest'.
critical_code_review_comments: BrandingBootstrapper relies on an id that CRA strips — brittle. Should fall back to querySelector by rel attribute (robust against build-time HTML transforms).
pwa.py: _render_initials_png / _resize_logo_png import PIL inside the function (ok, lazy). Pillow handles bad logos via try/except — verified with 1x1 PNG, no crash.
messagerie.py: send_message_core attachment URL validation is strong (rejects javascript: via allowlist of http/https/data:image|video|audio|application/pdf). Good.
seed_data_creation: None; broadcast created 1 extra message per active customer (acceptable per spec).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iter52_messagerie_pwa.py covers all messagerie endpoints + PWA manifest/icons incl. user-provided logo. Dynamic manifest swap on frontend is broken due to stripped id — see action_items. After E1 patches BrandingBootstrapper, re-run the frontend check (reload /boutique, read link[rel=manifest].href).
rca of the issue: Served index.html (both preview and localhost CRA dev) renders `<link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.json" />` without the id. The sibling icon links keep id=dynamic-favicon / dynamic-apple-icon. Hypothesis: HtmlWebpackPlugin / InterpolateHtmlPlugin removes extra attributes on `<link rel=manifest>` because it is treated specially (webmanifest injection). Simple mitigation: query by `link[rel="manifest"]` in BrandingBootstrapper.
